_README: How the automation finds each NS Retail control.
Tracked in git: no paths, no credentials - only control identities.
The routine, as performed by the operator:
Reports -> Stock Reports -> Purchases -> set the date -> F3 ->
tick every column -> Apply and Search -> Report ->
Export To... -> CSV File -> OK -> type the file name -> Save
NS Retail keeps its dialogs INSIDE the main form rather than as top-level
windows, so most windows here use "inside": "main" with an auto_id.
VERIFIED = run against the real application. CONFIRMED = read from an
inspection. TODO = still needs a capture.

windows._comment: NS Retail is a WinForms MDI app (main form auto_id 'frmMain'). Screens open inside the main window and the title becomes 'Victory Bazars - [<screen>]'. The WindowsForms10 class-name suffix changes between launches - match on the title.

login._status: TODO - not needed while login.enabled is false

report_viewer._status: CONFIRMED 2026-09-09 - the generated report opens as a child window of frmMain named 'Preview' (auto_id PrintPreviewRibbonFormExBase), a DevExpress print preview. It is not a top-level window and not the MDI 'Report Viewer' screen.

save_dialog._status: TODO - the Windows 'Save As' dialog; expected to be top-level with class #32770.

column_settings._status: CONFIRMED 2026-09-09 - child window of frmMain, auto_id frmIncludeExclude.

csv_options._status: CONFIRMED 2026-09-09 - the 'CSV Export Options' dialog is a child window called LinesForm inside the Preview window, not a top-level dialog. Its OK button still needs a capture.

steps._comment: Each step lists the controls to act on, in order.

open_reports.description: VERIFIED 2026-09-09 - the 'Reports' tab on the ribbon.

open_stock_reports.description: VERIFIED 2026-09-09 - 'Stock Reports' button in the Reports ribbon group. Scoped to the ribbon because a second button with the same name lives in the left auto-hide panel.

targets.description: Stock Reports button on the ribbon
targets.title: Stock Reports

select_purchase_report.description: TODO - capture the screen after Stock Reports opens, where Purchases is chosen.

set_date.description: VERIFIED 2026-09-09 on the running application - typing '08 September 2026' into both pickers took effect. The Edit inside each picker has an automation id that is really a window handle and changes every launch, so it is found through its parent ComboBox instead.

open_column_settings.description: VERIFIED workflow step - F3 on the Purchases screen opens the Include/Exclude column dialog. Waits for the dialog to actually appear.

include_all_columns.description: CONFIRMED 2026-09-09 - the Include/Exclude grid is a DevExpress table (gcIncExc) whose cells report 'Checked'/'Unchecked'. Only unticked rows are touched, so anything already selected stays selected, and the grid is paged through because it only loads visible rows.

targets.description: tick every column in the Include grid

apply_and_search.description: CONFIRMED 2026-09-09 - 'Apply and Search' (auto_id btnApplyAndSearch) inside the frmIncludeExclude dialog. This is what performs the search in the operator's routine - the Search button on the criteria panel is not used.

search.description: NOT USED in this workflow - the operator searches from inside the F3 dialog instead. Kept as a verified fallback: btnSearch on the criteria panel. apply_and_search takes precedence whenever it is mapped.

export_to.description: CONFIRMED 2026-09-09 - 'Export To' is a SplitButton in the Preview ribbon's Export toolbar. Opening it shows the format list (PDF/HTML/.../CSV).
